name: AgentScope
label: Agent scope
description: How far an agent may go in each area of an account, from off to act, never past the person who connected it.

props.name: permissions
props.description: The areas an agent can be let into, in the order they are listed.

props.name: value
props.description: The level the agent holds in each area, keyed by permission id, for controlled use. An area missing from it is off. Pair with `onValueChange`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The levels to begin with, for uncontrolled use. An agent starts with nothing: an area missing from it is off.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with every area's level when the reader changes one.

props.name: levelLabels
props.description: The words for each level. Defaults to Off, View, Prepare and Act.

props.name: approvalLabel
props.description: The note an area that moves money adds to its description, in place of `act`. Defaults to "A person approves".

props.name: hiddenLabel
props.description: The closing line counting the areas left out because the person does not hold them, given the count already written in the locale. Return an empty string to leave it out.
props.defaultExpression:
(count: string) =>
  count === '1' ? '1 more area is left out: you don’t hold it yourself.' : `${count} more areas are left out: you don’t hold them yourself.`

props.name: disabled
props.description: Hold every area at its current level.

props.name: locale
props.description: The BCP 47 locale the closing count is written in, such as `ar-EG`. Defaults to the nearest LocaleProvider's, then `en-US`.

AgentScopeLevel.description: How far an agent may go in one area, lowest first: nothing, look, draft for a person to approve, do it itself.

AgentScopeLevelLabels.description: The words for each level, as the segments show them.

AgentScopePermission.description: One area of the account an agent can be let into.
